msg: I was previously given advice to stick to the short hatted mushrooms and switch to the long hat mushrooms when the mushrooms I get from the forest go below 5 (the range is 0-9).I personally found that the short hatted mushroom very consistently gave me higher numbers, so I stuck to those 85% of the time. The only time I went for the longer hat mushrooms was when I would earn 0 mushrooms a couple times in a row.
